kind: Copied-state angular representation diagnostic; no new standing reference trial

inputs.phase: After native motor configuration, before world.step

hypotheses: A material mismatch between native motor position coordinates/Jacobians and application quaternion coordinates contributes to the retained failure.

A bounded signed motor bias produces a repeatable first-step response; a spike confined to constrained angular directions or contact-coupled response requires deeper solver instrumentation, not gain tuning.

physical.startup: No startup replacement. Restore copies solely for offline diagnostics; original H74 histories remain authoritative.
physical.invariants: Preserve all body/collider identities within each copy, dynamic types, mass, timestep, solver settings, joint frames/DOFs/limits, collision hooks, motor caps, stiffness/damping and original commands except the declared single-axis velocity bias. No body-state setters. No live controller or fall-guard changes.

budget.onExhaustion: Preserve all partial outputs; failed/incomplete result, no automatic retry or budget extension.

perturbations.axes: All declared anatomical axes of these ten segments: fourteen total
perturbations.implementation: Change only native targetVelocity by biasNm / native damping, rounded by the existing f32 ABI. Keep native maxForce unchanged. Reject any pre-step requested-effort cap crossing; do not clip or substitute another magnitude.
perturbations.independentMagnitude: 0.25 Nm characterizes sign; 0.5 Nm checks the same mechanism without adaptive selection.
perturbations.controls: Two untouched restores of each saved state, bit-exact against all 25 recorded bodies; each of 56 signed commands also repeats independently.

measurements.native: Read-only pinned-source reconstruction of all 24 joints at each saved pre-step pose: motor/limit coordinates, raw and finalized constraint Jacobians, RHS, inverse effective row mass, CFM, impulse bounds, masks and stored previous-step impulses. Native rows are frozen-pose reconstructions, not an instrumented trace of WASM internal substeps. No delivered whole-step motor-torque claim.
measurements.application: Quaternion joint coordinates, analytic coordinate Jacobians and finite-difference validation with 1e-6 rad algebraic rotations; projected native relative rates, locked-direction rates and pose-derived rates.
measurements.response: All 25 complete output body states and native snapshots; motor command delta/readback; per-joint/forefoot angular vectors; actual contact manifolds, solver contacts and normal impulses; linear/angular peaks; requested motor bounds; anchor and limit errors; per-trial RSS/heap/external/arrayBuffers and wall time.
measurements.provenance: Verify prior inventories, all source snapshot members, src and lockfile parity, installed runtime/dependency hashes, Node executable, native source archive parity and Rust build/toolchain/features. Preserve working-tree diff/status and exact diagnostic sources/commands. Recheck at completion.

criteria.signedResponse: Compare relative rate along the perturbed native motor axis against the control. Both magnitudes must produce opposite signed changes exceeding 0.001 rad/s to support simple signed local authority; otherwise label unresolved/coupled, including cap/limit/contact evidence.
criteria.repairGate: No repair from representation differences alone. Require a material discrepancy at the failing joint, consistent signed evidence at both magnitudes, and a localized source-backed correction preserving physical constraints. Otherwise report diagnostic complete but feasibility failed/incomplete and freeze a separate next experiment before testing a repair.
criteria.abort: Integrity/runtime/source mismatch, nonfinite data, changed physical settings, ownership/setter violation, cap violation, replay mismatch or budget violation invalidates dependent diagnostics. Keep all failed evidence.
criteria.acceptance: No standing, local-return, backup-region, H73 or browser acceptance checkbox may close from these copied one-step probes. Official limits remain 0.1 m/s and 0.5 rad/s; H74 reference reserves remain separate.
